newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria sets October 23 date for local elections.
newsitem.headline: Algeria sets October 23 date for local elections.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual announced on Wednesday that local elections will be held on October 23, a statement said.
The announcement was carried by the official Algerian news agency APS.
Algerian voters will elect mayors and local councils in the North African country's 48 main cities and more than 1,500 towns and villages.
The ballot will also complete the shape of Algeria's new parliament as elected local authorities will vote on 144 members of the Council of the Nation, the upper house.
The president will appoint the other third from the ranks of leading personalities, union officials and other professionals.
According to the constitution adopted last November, the National Assembly, or lower house, and the Council of the Nation form the parliament.
